title: Crossroads of Fate
next_chapter_hook: Amid the deafening roar of the Three Realms collapsing, Chen Ji's voice was terrifyingly calm: "I will take the fourth path—the path that shatters all chess games."

text.content: Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul, like a candle flame in the wind, was finally extinguished. Chen Ji knelt on one knee, the Reversing Fate Talisman in his palm radiating a cold and eerie glow, as if mocking this vast heaven and earth. Mo Xiansheng's final words before his dissolution still echoed in Chen Ji's ear—"Only one chance." Yes, one chance. Success means breaking the shackles of fate; failure means eternal destruction. He slowly rose to his feet, his gaze sweeping across the twisted void before him. Three light gates materialized from thin air—the left glowing with pale cyan cold light, the right burning with ghostly blue demonic flames, and the center emanating a strange golden radiance. Behind each gate, a familiar silhouette could be vaguely seen. Chen Ji's fingers tightened slightly, his knuckles turning white. He knew this was the final trap the Heavenly Eye had laid for him—using the fates of those he cherished most to force him into making a choice.

The scene behind the left pale-cyan gate gradually clarified—Su Qingyao stood proudly atop the ruins of the Tianqing Sect, countless sword lights circling her body, yet she was self-detonating her primordial spirit to seal the erupting demonic tide. Her expression was resolute, but her eyes held a sense of relief, as if she had finally been waiting for this moment. "With my life, I shall purchase peace for all living beings." Her voice穿越虚空, clearly reaching Chen Ji's ears. Next, within the right demonic flame gate, Ye Qing's figure emerged. She was surrounded by eerie black mist—that was the primordial form of the Demonic Path Fog—she was burning her Saint Maiden fate to tear open an escape rift for Chen Ji. And behind the central golden gate, it was his missing sister, Chen Nian. She floated silently in a realm of chaos, eyes tightly shut, bound by countless golden chains—those were the source of the Heavenly Fate Lock.

dialogue.content: "Do you see it?" A voice transcending human comprehension rang from all directions, as if echoing directly in the soul, "This is your fate. The three people most deeply bound to you will all die for you. Unless..." Above the heavens, a massive eye slowly opened, its pupil swirling with the birth and destruction of countless stars, "You make a choice." Chen Ji looked up at that eye, yet the corner of his mouth curved into a mocking arc. The Heavenly Eye? The lofty master of fate? He slowly raised the Reversing Fate Talisman in his hand, feeling the terrifying power contained within: "Finished?"

text.content: The eye contracted slightly, seemingly not expecting Chen Ji's reaction. "You don't want to save them?" Its voice carried a hint of confusion and amusement. Chen Ji gave no answer, instead walking slowly toward the three light gates. His gaze swept across Su Qingyao, Ye Qing, and Chen Nian's faces in turn, finally stopping on that massive eye suspended in the heavens. "Of course I want to save them." His voice was terrifyingly calm, "But I never believe in choices given to me by fate." As his words fell, the Reversing Fate Talisman in his hand suddenly erupted with blinding light, a force that shot straight into the clouds, causing even that massive Heavenly Eye to flinch.

dialogue.content: "Do you think that broken talisman can do anything to me?" The Heavenly Eye's voice gained a cold edge, "I have existed for billions of years, witnessing countless civilizations rise and fall. You are merely another ant attempting to challenge the heavens—" Before it could finish, however, Chen Ji suddenly laughed. That laughter echoed through the empty void, carrying an indescribable mockery and desolation. "Billions of years?" He cut off the Heavenly Eye, "But you don't even know what you are." The Heavenly Eye's pupil contracted sharply, countless stars spinning wildly within it. Chen Ji felt a terrifying pressure pour down from that eye, yet he still straightened his spine: "You think I don't know? You are not the master of heaven—you are a prisoner."

text.content: The void suddenly froze. That Heavenly Eye's rotation halted for an instant, then erupted with blinding golden light. When the radiance faded, a middle-aged man in a golden robe materialized before Chen Ji as a phantom. His features were too blurred to distinguish, yet he exuded an suffocating pressure. "How did you know?" His voice no longer carried the previous lofty arrogance, but a barely concealed terror. Chen Ji looked at the true face of this so-called heaven, a glimmer of understanding flickering in his eyes: "The fragments of the Tianji Record contain a legend—the Heavenly Eye was not born as a master, but a wretch imprisoned here by beings of higher dimensions. Your claimed 'mastery of fate' is merely a bone thrown to a prisoner by the Fourth Dimension."

dialogue.content: The golden-robed phantom fell silent for a moment. When he spoke again, all arrogance had vanished from his voice, replaced by a complex emotion intertwining exhaustion and longing: "Yes... I am a prisoner. A prisoner for billions of years." He slowly raised his hand, pointing to the three light gates, "Did you think this was a trap I set? You're wrong. This is the final chance I give you—and myself." His gaze burned with intensity, "Choosing the path of the Chess Player, you will become a new puppet of heaven, continuing this endless chess game. Choosing the path of Freedom, sacrifice one person, release the others. Choosing mutual destruction... we both dissipate in this void." His voice dropped lower, "Or, you can use that Reversing Fate Talisman... cut this chain, and grant me liberation as well."

text.content: Chen Ji listened quietly, yet his eyes held not the slightest波动. Three paths, each filled with calculation and lies. The Chess Player's path merely seats another puppet on the board; the Freedom path's price is personally pushing his beloved into the abyss, and mutual destruction... He looked at Chen Nian behind the central gate, his sister bound by the Heavenly Fate Lock, and finally a tremor appeared in his gaze. "You calculated my entire life." Chen Ji slowly spoke, his voice ice-cold, "From the moment Elder Chen Xuan obtained the Tianji Record, you began your scheme. You exploited his trust in heaven, transforming the Tianji Record into a tool controlling the mortal realm. You made every inheritor your piece, believing one day they could break the cage of the Fourth Dimension—but you never considered their fates were just as pitiful as your own."

dialogue.content: The golden-robed phantom's lips twitched slightly—an expression Chen Ji had never seen before—something between fury and pain. "What do you know?" His voice suddenly rose, shaking the entire void, "Billions of years of solitude! Billions of years of imprisonment! I watched my children born, grow, and die generation after generation, yet never able to touch true freedom—do you think I don't want to break all this?" His eye sockets actually glimmered with hidden tears, "But I cannot... I am a prisoner, unable to actively break free from the chains. I can only wait, wait for a piece strong enough to appear... wait for someone capable of cutting through fate—" He猛地 looked at Chen Ji, his eyes burning with mad fire, "It is you! Chen Ji! The Reversing Fate Talisman in your hand is the only divine artifact from the Fourth Dimension that wandered outside—only it can sever these chains!"

choice.prompt: Three gates of fate rotated before Chen Ji, the Heavenly Eye's true form as a prisoner fully revealed. At this crossroads of destiny, what choice will he make?

choices.description: Sacrifice Su Qingyao alone, release Ye Qing and Chen Nian, trading one life for two, continuing the current balance
choices.visible_reward: Preserving Ye Qing and his sister's lives
choices.risk_hint: Can the Heavenly Eye's promise be trusted?

text.content: Chen Ji's gaze wandered between Su Qingyao and Ye Qing. His hand slowly rose, pointing to the left pale-cyan gate. The moment his fingertip touched the light gate, a poignant sword glow suddenly blazed—that was Su Qingyao's final glance back, carrying relief and sorrow. Chen Ji clenched his fists tightly, nails digging deep into his palms, blood dripping through his fingers. At this moment, his eyes held no tears, only deep-seated hatred and cold calculation. He remembered. When he broke free from this chessboard of fate, he would return.

choices.description: Take the Heavenly Eye's position, become the new ruler of the chessboard, gaining the power to change fate at the cost of sacrificing the two sisters
choices.visible_cost: Losing Ye Qing and Chen Nian

text.content: Chen Ji walked toward the central golden gate. His face held no expression whatsoever, as if looking at two irrelevant objects. Ye Qing and Chen Nian's figures gradually blurred within the light, and he could feel their despairing gazes, yet he merely slowly closed his eyes. When he opened them again, countless star trajectories were reflected in his pupils—that was the perspective of heaven. From now on, he would be the new ruler of the chessboard. The price was the eternal annihilation of the two sisters, and the last shred of his conscience.

choices.description: Use the Reversing Fate Talisman to trigger the Tianji Record's backlash, destroying the Heavenly Eye together, buying a sliver of hope for the Three Realms in destruction
choices.risk_hint: The Three Realms will fall into chaos

text.content: Chen Ji laughed toward the heavens, that laughter filled with desolation and resolve. He threw the Reversing Fate Talisman high into the air, letting it float in the void. "You imprisoned me? What a joke!" His voice shook the heavens, "I, Chen Ji, never choose from multiple choice questions!" The Reversing Fate Talisman erupted with light that pierced through countless ages, colliding with the Heavenly Eye's radiance. A violent explosion swept through the Three Realms, Su Qingyao, Ye Qing, and Chen Nian's figures flickering like phantoms in the chaos. And in his final moment of consciousness, Chen Ji saw all three sisters turn simultaneously, smiling at him.

However, just as the three light gates trembled in unison and the Heavenly Eye showed a hint of anticipation, the corner of Chen Ji's mouth slowly curved upward. He raised the Reversing Fate Talisman in his hand, but instead of pointing it at any light gate, he aimed it at the golden-veiled heavens above. "You're right—this Reversing Fate Talisman is a divine artifact of the Fourth Dimension." His voice was terrifyingly calm, each word like a heavy hammer striking the void, "But you forgot one thing—I am the inheritor of the Tianji Record, and you are merely a prisoner." His pupils contracted sharply, unprecedented light bursting from his eyes, "You arranged this scheme for billions of years, just waiting for this moment of mine. But did you ever consider—why would the Tianji Record choose a废物?"

dialogue.content: Chen Ji took a step forward, the Reversing Fate Talisman's radiance growing increasingly intense. He stared directly at the golden-robed phantom's blurred face, speaking word by word: "Because you were wrong. The Tianji Record never chooses the strongest piece, but the soul most unwilling to be manipulated." His voice grew louder and louder, almost a roar by the end, "Did you think you were using me? No—it was I who used you! From the moment Elder Chen Xuan handed me the Tianji Record, I knew you were the mastermind behind the scenes. I waited for three volumes, waited for you to personally reveal yourself—and now, you finally stand before me!" He slammed the Reversing Fate Talisman against his chest, emitting a low laugh, "Three paths? Listen to me—"

text.content: Chen Ji let out a long roar toward the heavens, his voice penetrating层层虚空, reaching the boundary of the Fourth Dimension. The three light gates trembled simultaneously, and Su Qingyao, Ye Qing, and Chen Nian all turned their heads at the same time, their eyes full of shock and disbelief. "I will take the fourth path!" His voice echoed through the void, causing the golden-robed phantom of the Heavenly Eye to stumble backward repeatedly, "The path that shatters all chess games!" The Reversing Fate Talisman resonated with the Tianji Record within Chen Ji's body, erupting with power capable of tearing the heavens apart. He felt the gaze of the Fourth Dimension rushing over frantically—that was a terrifying existence he had never touched before—and he faced it with a smile.

dialogue.content: "You're insane!" The Heavenly Eye's voice carried genuine fear for the first time, the golden-robed phantom trembling violently, as if about to collapse at any moment, "You don't know what you're doing! The beings of the Fourth Dimension are not something you can oppose—you will destroy yourself, destroy everyone!" Chen Ji laughed instead, that smile carrying a twisted joy: "Destroy everyone? Ha..." He猛地 turned, looking at the three figures behind the three light gates, "Did you think they would be afraid?" His gaze swept across Su Qingyao's resolute face, Ye Qing's burning battle intent, and Chen Nian's tightly clenched fists even in slumber, "They have waited for this day even longer than I have!"

text.content: The Three Realms fell into eerie silence at this moment. As Chen Ji's words fell, the three light gates actually began to crack simultaneously. Su Qingyao's figure stepped out first, her sword transforming into countless sword lights, weaving an impenetrable sword net around her. Ye Qing followed closely behind, the Demonic Path Fog surging wildly, shrouding half the sky. Chen Nian awakened from her slumber, those eyes identical to Chen Ji's reflecting the end and restart of fate. "Brother." Chen Nian's voice was gentle yet firm, "We have waited for this day for a very long time." Chen Ji looked at his sister, and for the first time, a genuine smile appeared at the corner of his mouth. Amid the deafening roar of the Three Realms collapsing, Chen Ji's voice was terrifyingly calm: "The fourth path—we walk it together."
